title: stream-interleaving-and-prefetch-fence-for-reduced-comm-stalls-in-tensor-parallel
author: Ravi Patel
description: Motivation: reduce multi‑GPU stalls caused by head-of-line NCCL waits and KV cache prefetch serialization for tensor‑parallel workloads. This PR introduces a lightweight stream‑interleaving scheduler, a prefetch fence that decouples KV prefetch from blocking collective submission, and a small NCCL tuning pass that picks stream affinities per-rank. Changes are targeted to the TP runtime path only and include microbenchmarks and a fallback for older NCCL versions. Key benefits: fewer idle CUDA cycles during long decode sequences, improved overlap between communication and compute for per-layer allgather patterns, and more deterministic p99. Summary of changes follows in commits and files_changed. Notes: description is a single continuous string to preserve GitHub PR prose style and contains checklists and test notes inline.
commits: scheduler: introduce StreamInterleaving policy and unit tests
gpu: add nccl_affinity tuner and version gate
kvcache: introduce prefetch_fence + nonblocking prefetch path
runtime: wire stream interleaving into tp dispatcher
bench: add long-seq tp microbench harness (8xA100)

Ravi Patel: Added a version gate and a slower fallback that keeps the legacy submission ordering. See nccl_tuner.cc (second commit).
Zoe Kim: Bench numbers look promising; please add p95/p99 distributions and CI rerun to ensure stability.
Ravi Patel: Uploaded extended runs (8xA100, 4 seeds) and added p95/p99 charts to docs/perf. CI bench job re-ran and passed.
Marcus Liu: Approve after minor comment about a log level change for the tuner (suggest debug).
release_notes: Runtime: added stream interleaving and nonblocking KV prefetch fence for tensor-parallel; improves overlap of comm/compute and reduces p99 on long decode workloads. Backwards-compatible with older NCCL via fallback.
perf_numbers: 8xA100-40GB, GPT-like 16k seq: throughput +18% end-to-end vs main (same batch size)
GPU utilization uplift: +9% sustained on TP layers with heavy allgather
testing_notes: Unit tests added for stream scheduler correctness; microbench harness integrated into CI bench stage. Manual verification performed on an internal 8xA100 cluster; regression tests for kvcache prefetch added.
notes_for_ops: Feature gated behind runtime flag runtime.tp_stream_interleave (default true for pools with NCCL>=2.14). Fallback enabled for NCCL<2.14; operators can disable via config if necessary.
extra_context: Related work: builds on earlier TP scheduling PRs but uses a different approach: per-rank stream affinity + prefetch fence to prevent head-of-line blocking. See ENG-2184 for rollout plan and perf targets.
